title: Infografía de Línea de Tiempo del Viaje de Cuatro Etapas hacia el Dominio del Machine Learning
prompt:
A modern flat vector infographic with a vertical timeline layout, illustrating a four-stage machine learning mastery journey titled "THE PATH TO ML MASTERY". The infographic is divided into four horizontal sections from top to bottom, connected by a central dashed arrow line flowing downward.

Stage 1 (Top section, warm Yellow/Orange gradient theme #FFB84D to #FFA726): A simple flat illustrated character (diverse gender-neutral person) with an excited, wide-eyed expression and raised arms in celebration pose. Surrounding icons include: a glowing lightbulb, sparkles, an open book, and a graduation cap. Stage title in bold sans-serif: "CURIOSITY & FOUNDATION". Subtitle text: "Learning Python basics, statistics, and linear algebra".

Stage 2 (Second section, vibrant Pink/Red gradient theme #FF6B9D to #E91E63): The same character now looking dizzy and overwhelmed, hand on forehead in confusion gesture. Surrounding icons include: a tangled brain with question marks, messy code snippets, confused symbols (?!), and swirling spiral. Stage title in bold sans-serif: "COMPLEXITY OVERLOAD". Subtitle text: "Struggling with neural networks, backpropagation, and model tuning".

Stage 3 (Third section, cool Blue/Purple gradient theme #5E92F3 to #673AB7): The character looking focused and determined, sitting at a laptop/computer interface with concentration. Surrounding icons include: debugging tools icon, a CPU/GPU chip, terminal window, Jupyter notebook logo, and a gear/wrench for optimization. Stage title in bold sans-serif: "PRACTICE & APPLICATION". Subtitle text: "Building real projects: NLP chatbots, computer vision, predictive models".

Stage 4 (Bottom section, fresh Green gradient theme #66BB6A to #43A047): The character looking confident and successful with a proud smile, arms crossed or thumbs up gesture. Surrounding icons include: a rocket launching upward, an upward trending graph/chart, a trophy/medal, a star badge, and GitHub logo. Stage title in bold sans-serif: "COMPETENCE & GROWTH". Subtitle text: "Deploying models to production, contributing to open source, landing ML role".

Overall design specifications:
- Clean sans-serif typography (similar to Inter, Poppins, or Roboto)
- Pure white background (#FFFFFF)
- Clean, thick connecting dashed arrow line in dark gray (#424242) flowing through all four stages
- Each stage is a distinct horizontal band with rounded corner container
- Approachable, friendly, and professional flat design style
- Icons are simple, geometric, and minimalist
- Character illustrations use simple shapes with consistent style across all panels
- High contrast between text and background for readability
- Modern SaaS/startup aesthetic
- 8K resolution, vector-crisp rendering
